text.zh: 大赛前夜，你睡不着。你的赛前仪式是……
text.en: The night before the big match, you can't sleep. Your pre-game ritual is…

label.zh: 穿那双从不洗的「幸运臭袜子」，三年没输过（其实输过）
label.en: Wear the unwashed 'lucky socks' — unbeaten in three years (you have lost)

label.zh: 固定路线热身、右脚先进场，一步都不能错
label.en: Same warm-up route, right foot out first — not one step wrong

label.zh: 更衣室放最炸的音乐，带头蹦迪点燃全队
label.en: Blast the loudest music in the dressing room and get everyone bouncing

label.zh: 玄学？我只信训练数据和睡眠监测
label.en: Superstition? I only trust the training data and my sleep tracker
